svg.text: Live canonical prop SVGs, including alternate operational states.

svg.title: QuotaCo low-staple bike rack
svg.desc: Plan-projected three-hoop bicycle rack with wide locking spaces, six explicit ground mounts, and one employee lock.
svg.metadata: Accepted low-staple-bank exterior source. Existing 2x1 footprint remains template-owned.

svg.title: QuotaCo campus fleet car
svg.desc: Plan-projected institutional sedan with a clear glazed cabin, service lights, bounded wear, and one employee marker.
svg.metadata: Accepted lived-campus exterior source. Existing 4x2 footprint and trim parameter remain template-owned.

svg.title: QuotaCo offset-arm street light
svg.desc: Elevation-projected service mast with an unmistakable offset shielded lamp head and a compact access panel.
svg.metadata: Accepted offset-service-arm exterior source. Existing 1x1 footprint remains template-owned.

svg.title: QuotaCo campus crosswalk marking
svg.desc: Five broad plan-projected crossing bars with a clean functional silhouette and no service frame.
svg.metadata: Accepted institutional-site-kit exterior source. Existing 2x2 footprint remains template-owned.

svg.title: QuotaCo lived-campus park bench
svg.desc: Elevation-projected institutional bench with a clear back, seat, grounded supports, localized wear, and one employee note.
svg.metadata: Accepted lived-campus exterior source. Existing 2x1 footprint remains template-owned.
